episode.title: The Sunday Cafe
intro: On Sunday morning, Emma goes to the cafe downstairs. Claire introduces Leo. Leo helps at the cafe every Sunday. He brings fresh bread from his bakery job. Emma takes a few photos.
日曜日の朝、エマは階下のカフェに行きます。クレアはレオを紹介します。レオは毎週日曜日にカフェを手伝います。パン屋の仕事先から焼きたてのパンを持ってきます。エマは写真を何枚か撮ります。
goal: I can understand a short self-introduction about past and present work.
過去と今の仕事についての短い自己紹介を聞いて理解できる。
episode.warmup: What do you want to know about a cafe worker?
words: ブリストルで育ちました。
I moved to Kyoto last spring.
去年の春に京都に引っ越しました。
I used to work in a hotel kitchen.
以前はホテルのキッチンで働いていました。
I got a job at a bakery.
パン屋の仕事が決まりました。
I help at this cafe every Sunday.
毎週日曜日にこのカフェを手伝います。
I brought some fresh bread today.
今日は焼きたてのパンを持ってきました。
discussion: Say where you grew up and one thing you do every week.
育った場所と、毎週することを1つ言いましょう。

rule: Listen for past and present words. They tell the time.
過去と現在の言葉を聞きましょう。いつの話か分かります。
examples: I grew up in Bristol. Now I live in Kyoto.
ブリストルで育ちました。今は京都に住んでいます。

rule: Listen for because. It gives a reason.
because に注目しましょう。理由が分かります。
examples: I moved to Kyoto because I got a bakery job.
パン屋の仕事が決まったので京都に引っ越しました。

situation: Claire introduces Leo to Emma. Listen to Leo. Find his hometown, reason for moving, and Sunday routine.
クレアがエマにレオを紹介します。レオの話を聞いて、育った場所、引っ越した理由、日曜日の習慣を聞き取りましょう。
apply.text: Hi, I'm Leo. I grew up in Bristol. I moved to Kyoto last spring because I got a bakery job. I used to work in a hotel kitchen. Now I make bread early in the morning. Every Sunday, I help Claire at this cafe. I brought fresh bread. Please try some!
questions: He is meeting Emma at the cafe.
Why did he move to Kyoto?
He got a job at a bakery.

choose: He moved to Kyoto (because / but) he got a job.
He used to (work / worked) in a hotel kitchen.
Now he (makes / made) bread every morning.
He helps at the cafe (every / last) Sunday.
choices: Leo grew up in Bristol, but now lives in Kyoto. Where did he grow up?
He moved because he got a bakery job. Why did he move?
He helps Claire every Sunday. Is this a regular activity?
He used to work in a hotel kitchen. When was this?

situation: You are Emma. After trying Leo's bread, you listen as he tells you more. Later, Claire asks you about him. Your tutor reads Leo's message, then plays Claire.
あなたはエマ役です。レオのパンを食べた後、レオの話をもっと聞きます。その後、クレアがレオについて聞きます。講師はレオの話を読んでから、クレア役になります。
task: Listen for Leo's morning routine, favorite bread, and plan for next Sunday. Then answer Claire's questions. You can ask to hear it again.
レオの朝の習慣、好きなパン、次の日曜日の予定を聞き取りましょう。その後、クレアの質問に答えましょう。もう一度聞いても大丈夫です。
mission.text: I start work at six, so I get up at five. I usually cycle to the bakery. My favorite bread has cheese in it. Next Sunday, I want to bring some apple pastries to the cafe. I finish helping Claire at noon. Then I usually take a walk by the river.
lines: Emma, what time does Leo start work?
How does he get to the bakery?
What bread does he like best?
What does he want to bring next Sunday?
What does he usually do after helping me?
mission.evidence: Tutor evidence note: The correct details are: starts work at six, gets up at five, cycles to the bakery, favorite bread has cheese, wants to bring apple pastries next Sunday, finishes at noon, then takes a walk by the river. Grade meaning first. Minor grammar mistakes are OK. Repeat only the part the student missed.
useful: Could you repeat that part, please?

topics: What do you order at a cafe?
What time do you get up?
How do you go to work or school?
What do you do first in the morning?
trivia: "Bread" is usually uncountable. You can say "some bread," "a slice of bread," or "a loaf of bread."
英語の bread は普通は数えられません。some bread、a slice of bread、a loaf of bread のように言います。
triviaQuestion: What do you ask for if you want one thin piece of bread?
episode.closing: Emma enjoys the fresh bread and takes photos at the cafe. A few days later, she meets another resident with a camera.
